description.value: The Regal Beagle Bar & Grill has been a Kitsilano neighbourhood institution since 1997, situated on West Broadway in one of Vancouver's most bike-friendly districts. It offers a full bar and grill menu with weekend brunch, indoor seating, and outdoor seating — making it a natural rest stop for cyclists passing through the area. The relaxed local-pub atmosphere and central Kits location give it genuine appeal for anyone exploring the city by bike.
